partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Multisource LOF disinhibited-effector suppression
results.hypothesis: LOF downstream suppression is more reliable when independent databases support direct drug binding to the disinhibited effector.
results.body: R313 plus at least two distinct primary binding sources for the drug-effector pair
results.mechanism_rationale: The signed downstream mechanism is unchanged, while independent binding evidence reduces reliance on a single target database.
results.trapi_notes: The positive path is TRAPI-expressible; distinct binding-source aggregation and provenance constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(effector:Gene)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(effector)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(effector)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE driver <> effector
  AND 'infores:signor' IN
      coalesce(regulation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier IN
      ['upregulated', 'downregulated']
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'downregulated'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = CASE regulation.object_direction_qualifier
  WHEN 'upregulated' THEN 'increased'
  ELSE 'decreased'
END
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'

WITH subject, object, collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WITH subject, object,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,
         source IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, []) |
         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated
           ELSE accumulated + source
         END
       )
     ) AS binding_sources
WHERE size(binding_sources) >= 2

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Multisource LOF disinhibited-effector activation control
results.hypothesis: The multisource binding gate should not rescue the matched direction that further activates a disinhibited LOF effector.
results.body: R317 plus at least two distinct primary binding sources for the drug-effector pair
results.mechanism_rationale: Binding confidence is high, but the drug direction reinforces the LOF downstream defect.
